visual.title: Two sides, no edge inside
visual.caption: The six-cycle splits into two sides with every edge crossing between them. A two-colouring exists because the cycle has even length, and the two sides are the colour classes.

predict.question: A graph is bipartite exactly when:
predict.explain: A two-colouring exists exactly when no odd cycle can force a conflict. This six-cycle splits into A, C, E and B, D, F.
